newsitem.title: USA: US to revise income, wealth estimates back to 1929.
newsitem.headline: US to revise income, wealth estimates back to 1929.

text.p: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis said Wednesday it would revise its estimates of national income and product accounts for 1929-1958 and reproducible tangible wealth for 1929-1995.
The revisions will be issued on Thursday at 9 a.m. EST (1300 GMT) in the bureau's May issue of "Survey of Current Business," it said.

The revisions, which are based on improvements in measuring real output and prices and in the method of calculating depreciation, could result in the restatement of U.S. personal income and the savings rate through 1996, a bureau spokesman said.
